description: This file defines a Java interface named CustomerAttributeDao for data access operations related to CustomerAttribute entities in a sales management system.

classes.name: CustomerAttributeDao
classes.description: Java interface extending SalesManagerEntityDao to provide data access methods for CustomerAttribute objects, including retrieval by option ID, option value ID, and customer ID.

methods.name: getByOptionId
methods.description: Retrieves a CustomerAttribute by MerchantStore, customer ID, and attribute option ID.

methods.name: getByOptionValueId
methods.description: Retrieves a list of CustomerAttributes by MerchantStore and option value ID.

methods.name: getByOptionId
methods.description: Retrieves a list of CustomerAttributes by MerchantStore and option ID.

methods.name: getByCustomerId
methods.description: Retrieves a list of CustomerAttributes by MerchantStore and customer ID.
